question: In The Secrets of Skyhorn Lighthouse, what creature is being summoned in the cave beneath the lighthouse, who is performing the summoning ritual, and what item are they using?
expected_answer: A water elemental is being summoned. The eelfolk scourge is forcing a captured sailor named Grigor to perform the ritual using the Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals.

bm25_simple.answer: Water elemental. Grigor (CN bandit, captive sailor) forced by eelfolk to perform ritual. Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals (fixed in cracked alabaster tiles, summons 2x/day). Eelfolk learned elementals turn on summoners. Source: Skyhorn Lighthouse PDF p.12-13.
sources_cited: The Secrets of Skyhorn Lighthouse V8-1.pdf p.12-13

quality.notes: Perfect answer in single query. All three elements (creature, performer, item) correct with rich context.
